typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		TRADE_DT as timestamp,
		SETTLEMENT_DT as timestamp,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as decimal(38,0),
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR as string,
		EXTNL_REF_ID as string,
		TAG_DT as timestamp,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as decimal(7,0),
		REMAINING_AMT as decimal(15,2),
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		ORIGIN_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		RR_CD as string,
		ASSETCLASS as string,
		PRODUCTID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of ORIGIN_CD} = ORIGIN_CD,
		{Copy of TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD} = TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD,
		{Copy of CURRENCY_CD} = CURRENCY_CD,
		{Copy of EFFDATE} = toDate(EFFDATE, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of RR_CD} = RR_CD,
		{Copy of TRANS_CONTROL_ID} = TRANS_CONTROL_ID,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD} = ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD,
		{Copy of SETTLEMENT_DT} = toDate(SETTLEMENT_DT, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of REMAINING_AMT} = REMAINING_AMT,
		{Copy of TAG_DPLCT_NBR} = TAG_DPLCT_NBR,
		{Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD} = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CD} = ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		{Copy of ASSETCLASS} = ASSETCLASS,
		{Copy of PRODUCTID} = PRODUCTID,
		{Copy of TRADE_DT} = toDate(TRADE_DT, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of BRANCH_CSTCY_CD} = BRANCH_CSTCY_CD,
		{Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR} = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		{Copy of BRANCH_CD} = BRANCH_CD,
		{Copy of TAG_CAGE_NBR} = TAG_CAGE_NBR,
		{Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD} = INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD,
		{Copy of TAG_DT} = TAG_DT,
		{Copy of BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR} = BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR,
		{Copy of EXTNL_REF_ID} = EXTNL_REF_ID,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		TRADE_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		REMAINING_AMT as integer,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as integer,
		EFFDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRODUCT as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR as string,
		RR_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		ORIGIN_CD as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		EXTNL_REF_ID as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR as string,
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		TAG_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADE_DT = {Copy of TRADE_DT},
		REMAINING_AMT = {Copy of REMAINING_AMT},
		CURRENCY_CD = {Copy of CURRENCY_CD},
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD},
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR = {Copy of TAG_DPLCT_NBR},
		EFFDATE = {Copy of EFFDATE},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD = {Copy of BRANCH_CSTCY_CD},
		SETTLEMENT_DT = {Copy of SETTLEMENT_DT},
		PRODUCT = {Copy of ASSETCLASS},
		CLIENT_NBR = {Copy of CLIENT_NBR},
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD = {Copy of TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD},
		ACCOUNT_CD = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CD},
		TAG_CAGE_NBR = {Copy of TAG_CAGE_NBR},
		RR_CD = {Copy of RR_CD},
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = {Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD},
		PRODUCT_ID = {Copy of PRODUCTID},
		EFFECTIVEDATE = {Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE},
		ORIGIN_CD = {Copy of ORIGIN_CD},
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD = {Copy of INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD},
		EXTNL_REF_ID = {Copy of EXTNL_REF_ID},
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = {Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR},
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR = {Copy of BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR},
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID = {Copy of TRANS_CONTROL_ID},
		BRANCH_CD = {Copy of BRANCH_CD},
		TAG_DT = {Copy of TAG_DT}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
